items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Wonderful music with Coleridge Perkinson as the one who took care of the voices, and that was 18 vocals and the musicians.

ctx.x: No. It took off and then they had to press more of course. But no. He had it on the beginning of the records, maybe he had hoped. But the public, in my opinion, cannot be predicted. And so you know for one that was just magnificent, Donald Byrd, “I’m Trying to Get Home.” They spent money that they really were very unhappy to spend that much money and they wanted it to be the gigantic thing that it should have been but it didn’t. It was great. Wonderful music with Coleridge Perkinson as the one who took care of…
